unique_value: every telemetry observation produces a deterministic receipt carrying channel, value, severity, residual, suppression state, and fingerprint
unknown telemetry channels fail visibly as HARD anomalies rather than being silently ignored
warning and hard thresholds produce explicit residual distance from the active limit so anomaly magnitude is preserved
acknowledgement can mark a non-nominal receipt suppressed only when an explicitly registered ack token is presented; the anomaly receipt is still emitted

lineage_distinction.GlacierEQ/nasa-command-authority-half-li: owns time-bounded command authority and replay-safe execution authorization; complementary command plane, not telemetry anomaly evidence

capability_contribution.ownership: This repository remains the owning NASA-specialist implementation of deterministic telemetry anomaly evidence receipts; capability extraction preserves repository identity and lineage.

next_evolution: Add time-series window provenance, signed sensor/source identity, stale-sample and sequence-gap detection, bounded acknowledgement expiry/ownership, and anomaly-to-command evidence linking while preserving visible receipts for every suppression decision.
nonclaims: not a production spacecraft telemetry deployment
repository relationships do not imply exercised integration
